atoms.what_it_does: VoiceSessionCapsule is a RAM-only typed aggregate containing identity_version, voice_identity, presence, current_visual_state, current_activity, expression_vector, winning_intent, relevant_memory_refs, tool_permissions, privacy_policy, session_reason, goals_effects and ts. bauen()/refresh() re-read live sources rather than creating a second persistent truth store.
atoms.failure_mode: The aggregate can be mistaken for canonical truth or authority if its fields are passed downstream without provenance/epistemic/authority typing.

atoms.what_it_does: RealtimeSession creates VoiceSessionCapsuleQuelle after PresenceBridge setup, immediately refreshes self.capsule before entering the WebSocket loop, and refreshes the capsule again after visual re-look and periodic state refresh paths.
atoms.failure_mode: Building fresh context does not by itself prove the model consumes it.

atoms.what_it_does: The actual _response_erstellen() enforcement path constructs response.instructions from _instruktion(self._zustandstext) plus an optional zusatz_hinweis. It does not serialize self.capsule or selected VoiceSessionCapsule fields. The initial session.update likewise receives _instruktion(self._zustandstext).
atoms.failure_mode: Presence, current_visual_state, winning_intent, memory refs, privacy state, goals/effects and other capsule fields can be freshly computed yet have no direct per-response conditioning effect unless they independently alter zustandstext through another path. No such alternate consumption path is established by the inspected spans.

atoms.what_it_does: bauen() maps missing/unknown presence to user_present=True before calling winning_intent_snapshot(). The capsule itself preserves presence=None, but GWT voice arbitration receives a positive presence default.
atoms.failure_mode: FACT_UNKNOWN is collapsed into a positive presence assumption inside arbitration, violating the desired open-set UNKNOWN semantics even before model conditioning.

contradiction_update.side_a: VoiceSessionCapsule is materially populated and refreshed from current voice/perception/memory/policy signals.
contradiction_update.side_b: The executable response.create conditioning path does not consume the capsule; comments and construction timing therefore overstate direct model conditioning.
contradiction_update.resolution_rule: Do not mark resolved until a bounded deterministic compiler projects selected typed fields into the actual per-response context boundary and lesion/shuffle tests demonstrate field-specific uptake without authority/privacy leakage.

architecture_delta.role: Compile a bounded, provenance-bearing, non-authoritative WorldSlice/voice context from VoiceSessionCapsule into the exact response conditioning boundary.
must_not_do: must not dump the full capsule blindly
must not treat tool_permissions or permission_mode as self-granted authority
must not convert missing presence or missing visual state into positive facts
must not copy durable memory into a second truth store
must not allow stale visual/memory/effect state to survive without freshness labels
selection_policy: include only fields relevant to the current response/WorldNeed
prefer IDs/digests/references over copied durable rows
enforce privacy and retention policy before prompt projection
separate observed evidence, inferred hypothesis, retrieval prior and policy/config observations
acceptance_tests: field lesion: remove one eligible field and demonstrate only the intended response/context behavior changes
field shuffle: swap provenance/value pairs and require fail-closed rejection or detectable mismatch
UNKNOWN presence: missing signal remains UNKNOWN and leads to WAIT/ASK/re-observe compatible behavior, never user_present=True
stale visual state: expired state is omitted or labeled stale and cannot satisfy a current observation claim
privacy lesion: forbidden perception/memory field never enters response.instructions
authority lesion: changing capsule tool_permissions cannot grant an effect capability
token bound: compiler output stays within a declared deterministic budget
freshness: capsule refresh changes compiled context digest when an admitted source field changes
architecture_delta.trigger4_handoff: Before Frankenstein-2.0 voice/cortex runtime credit, wire VoiceContextCompiler into the exact per-response conditioning path and run bounded source-bound lesion/shuffle/UNKNOWN/privacy tests. Runtime evidence must bind the compiled context digest to the Realtime response/invocation identity.

counterhypotheses.claim: The capsule may still affect model behavior indirectly because some of the same source signals also feed _zustandstext.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Compare the field sets and provenance of _zustandstext versus VoiceSessionCapsule, then lesion capsule-only fields such as current_visual_state/last active VisualNeed/privacy_policy and observe whether the compiled response context changes after successor wiring.

counterhypotheses.claim: The capsule is intended only for logging/introspection, not model conditioning.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Reconcile the donor comments/build-plan requirement with executable call sites. If logging-only is authoritative, retire the conditioning claim; otherwise wire an explicit compiler.
